mechanism_reasoning_rule: Task 2/3 mechanism_reasoning remains natural prose. It is adjudicated against a hidden pair-specific ground-truth causal chain; a correct mechanism label without the correct mediator, causal role/order, and intervention-to-outcome logic does not pass.

task2.note: v3.4.1 Task2A and Task2B are merged; log2FC magnitude is not predicted
task2.unit_pass_rule: predicted direction is correct AND all five reasoning-chain axes pass
task2.perturbation_input_policy: minimal coarse representation; exact method, dose, time, route, reagent and guide are evaluator-only
task2.duplicate_policy: identical simplified model inputs with identical labels are collapsed to one unit and all provenance is retained evaluator-side

task3.definition: entity-conditioned inverse intervention reasoning over nine bidirectional pairs
task3.multiple_answer_policy: any accepted perturbation for the same pair and supplied direction is correct
task3.unit_pass_rule: synonym-normalized intervention type matches an accepted type for the supplied entity AND all five reasoning-chain axes pass

perturbation_matching.entity: exact after case and punctuation normalization
perturbation_matching.intervention_type: curated synonym whitelist normalization before accepted-set comparison

task3.hidden_perturbation_information: intervention type and exact experimental implementation
task3.entity_conditioning_policy: one unit per pair, direction and distinct accepted perturbed entity; miR-181b and miR-181b-1 are collapsed to the vague entity miR-181b

hidden_data_policy: mechanism labels, accepted perturbation sets, controls, assays, contexts, sources and evidence are evaluator-only

reasoning_adjudication.method: blinded semantic adjudication against evaluator-only per-unit ground-truth chain rubrics
workflow: An adjudicator fills the five binary rubric axes without changing predictions or ground truth.
Run score_model_outputs.py with --reasoning-judgments to compute chain and joint metrics.
reasoning_adjudication.diagnostic_only: Exact standard-label mention may be reported but is not the chain score.

primary_scoring_principle: Outcome correctness and full ground-truth-chain correctness are jointly hard-gated at the unit level.
